page_title: BAY 0-1 WER | Bayern Munich v Werder Bremen 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+5' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
90+5' The foul by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) was seen by Marco Fritz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+4' Marco Fritz blows the whistle, Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Free kick. Werder Bremen will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+3' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
90+1' Konrad Laimer clips a neat ball into the box towards Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

90' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
89' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) replacing Felix Agu.
89' The substitution is prepared. Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Justin Njinmah.
88' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.

87' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) meets a nice cross deep inside the 18-yard box and produces a fine header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper is well positioned and punches the ball away, deflecting it onto the post.
84' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Kingsley Coman and he is replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch for Romano Schmid.
84' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
83' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
82' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
81' The attendance is 75000.
80' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
80' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends the corner into the box, but Michael Zetterer intercepts it and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
79' The corner by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

79' A sweet pass finds Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Michael Zetterer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Thomas Muller, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
74' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.

73' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
73' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
72' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner.
72' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
71' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
69' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
69' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) replaces Nick Woltemade.
65' That will be all from Alphonso Davies who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
65' The substitution has been made. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) has replaced Raphael Guerreiro.
64' Here is a change. Joshua Kimmich is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
62' Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.

62' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.

59' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the roof of the net and makes it 0:1. Manuel Neuer was helpless.
57' Bayern Munich are ruled offside.
57' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
54' What a miskick by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
50' Close! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
49' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Fritz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
45+2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
44' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
42' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) brought his opponent down.
38' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
36' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
35' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
34' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Konrad Laimer. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
29' Michael Zetterer pulls off a great save to deny Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
28' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
27' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Werder Bremen players look gutted.
27' Wait! Referee Marco Fritz has indicated he is going to review the Werder Bremen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
25' GOAL! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) runs onto a pass from Romano Schmid after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:1.
25' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

24' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Manuel Neuer, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
23' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
22' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Poor challenge! Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is penalised for tripping and Marco Fritz blows his whistle. A free kick to Bayern Munich.
17' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
12' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sprays a pass out to Justin Njinmah, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
10' The ball is cleared after Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Werder Bremen.
9' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Manuel Neuer is alert and denies him with a nice save.

7' He should have scored! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Michael Zetterer makes an easy save.
5' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. Marco Fritz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.

3' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Werder Bremen was in an offside position.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Marco Fritz will referee today's match.
